suggestions.title: Prisoners
suggestions.description: When his daughter and her friend go missing, a desperate father takes matters into his own hands against the prime suspect. Denis Villeneuve's taut, rain-soaked thriller is a masterclass in dread and moral ambiguity — anchored by powerhouse performances from Hugh Jackman and Jake Gyllenhaal, with a twisting, deeply unsettling mystery that never lets up.

suggestions.title: Before Sunrise
suggestions.description: A young American and a French student meet on a train and spend one magical night walking and talking through Vienna. Richard Linklater's intimate, dialogue-driven romance captures the electric thrill of a chance connection — two strangers, one unforgettable evening, and the melancholy beauty of knowing it may never happen again. Ethan Hawke and Julie Delpy are luminous.

suggestions.title: Free Solo
suggestions.description: Rock climber Alex Honnold attempts the first free solo climb of El Capitan's 3000-foot vertical rock face — with no ropes and no room for error. This Oscar-winning documentary is breathtaking and deeply human, a portrait of obsession, fear, and impossible achievement that will have your palms sweating from the very first frame.
